newsitem.title: CHINA: Chinese police detain veteran dissident Liu Xiaobo.
newsitem.headline: Chinese police detain veteran dissident Liu Xiaobo.

text.p: Chinese police detained veteran pro-democracy acitivist Liu Xiaobo early on Tuesday after searching his home and confiscating documents, family members said.
About seven or eight plainclothes and uniformed police, equipped with a search warrant, entered Liu's Beijing home at about 8.00 a.m. (0000 GMT), a relative said.

After searching the house and taking books, photographs and documents and articles that Liu had written, police took the dissident away. They gave no reason for the detention of the veteran of the 1989 student-led pro-democracy movement and did not say when he would be released.
"They gave no reason," the relative said. "They said to wait for notification."
